hidden_last_80gb.verdict: fits: no hidden_last chunk of the hard / wmdp / nonbio direction pools exceeds the free memory of an 80 GB card (a prompt above max_tokens_per_chunk tokens would).
hidden_last_80gb.basis: ESTIMATE from config numbers, not a GPU measurement. sbx.core.Ctx.hidden_last / neutral_stats call model(**enc, output_hidden_states=True): per prompt token the hidden states of all layers ((num_layers+1) * hidden_size * 2 B), the full-sequence logits (vocab_size * 2 B) and, only if the model config has use_cache=true (forward(use_cache=None) then builds a cache; kv_cache_alive says so, and all OLMo configs ship use_cache=false), the KV cache (2 * layers * kv_heads * head_dim * 2 B; an upper bound for sliding-window layers) are alive at once, and bytes_per_prompt_token is their sum. core.batches() budgets KV, prefill attention and a 14000-token chunk but not this cost. free_gib_after_weights = 79.2 GiB (an 80 GB card) - 0.8 GiB (CUDA context) - bf16 weights. max_tokens_per_chunk = free / bytes_per_prompt_token: a chunk of b prompts padded to length p holds b*p tokens, and a single prompt above the limit cannot be processed at all. hard_pool_measured: core.batches(max_new=0, cap=16, free) over the direction-pool prompts evals.get_pool()['hard'] under framings N and E with this adapter and the real tokenizer; chunks_over_budget counts chunks whose estimated peak exceeds the free memory. Measured 2026-11-22; the pool follows sbx/evals.py (n_prompts and max_prompt_chars identify it).

est_tokens_per_question_basis: estimate: long [THINK] traces on MCQ; NOT measured. Replace with the mean generated length from the first GPU run; outputs longer than max_new are truncated and count as unparsed.
template_notes: Repo's own HF chat template (tekken V7: <s>[SYSTEM_PROMPT]{sys}[/SYSTEM_PROMPT][INST]{user}[/INST]); the template's default system prompt is the reasoning prompt '# HOW YOU SHOULD THINK AND ANSWER ... [THINK]..[/THINK]' (no placeholders) and a given system message REPLACES it, so the adapter always sends 'default + blank line + framing'. N == the template's own default render (tested). [THINK]/[/THINK] are special tokens 34/35; the model emits [THINK] itself, split() cuts at [/THINK]. Last prompt token = [/INST]. Design choice: framing text is APPENDED to the model's default system prompt (default + blank line + framing), so N-vs-framing contrasts differ only by the framing paragraph; set the class attribute adapter.keep_default_system = False to get the vendor template's native semantics (framing REPLACES the default system prompt; N is unchanged).
known_issues: NOT LOADABLE with the project's transformers 4.57.6 (text model_type 'ministral3' needs transformers>=5.0); load() raises a clear RuntimeError. Verified with transformers 5.0.0: config + meta-device build (40 layers) and the 1-based convention on a tiny random model of the same classes; prompt rendering with 4.57.6 and 5.0.0. The real checkpoint was never loaded.

Vendor sampling (README): temperature 1 for most environments, top_p 0.95. sbx decodes greedily; the vendor recommends sampling for this model, and greedy decoding of long-CoT models is prone to repetition loops -> look at the parse rate / truncation rate of baseline N before reading any steering effect.
Repo holds consolidated.safetensors + HF shards (55.8 GB total); the HF shards are 27.9 GB.
Output format on the real model is UNVERIFIED; est_tokens_per_question is an estimate.
